name: Common Data 15
definition: Data common to all transactions of a data set.

Environment.name: Environment
Environment.definition: Data related to the environment of the transaction, common to a set of transaction.

Context.name: Context
Context.definition: Data related to the context of the transaction, common to a set of transaction.

TransactionType.name: Transaction Type
TransactionType.definition: Type of transaction being undertaken for the main service, common to a set of transaction.

AdditionalService.name: Additional Service
AdditionalService.definition: Service in addition to the main service.

ServiceAttribute.name: Service Attribute
ServiceAttribute.definition: Additional attribute of the service type.

MerchantCategoryCode.name: Merchant Category Code
MerchantCategoryCode.definition: Category code conform to ISO 18245, related to the type of services or goods the merchant provides for the transaction.

ReconciliationIdentification.name: Reconciliation Identification
ReconciliationIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the reconciliation period between the acceptor and the acquirer. This identification might be linked to the identification of the settlement for further verification by the merchant.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Currency associated with the set of transaction.
